caption: The video captures a close, static view of a clear curvy tumbler filled with transparent liquid. It rests on a light wooden surface against an orange wall and beige tile backsplash. A pale white rounded mass floats just beneath the waterline near the center of the glass. Small bubbles cling to the inner walls, and the surface shows a slight meniscus that stays steady. For most of the sequence the white mass holds its size and position, hovering without obvious drift. In the final moments the rounded form contracts, losing its fluffy outline. It becomes a smaller, flatter piece positioned slightly lower in the liquid. The glass outline, fill level, and background remain constant, with the camera holding still, leaving the reduction still underway toward the end.
